design.notes: Using standard E96 resistor value of 10.2 kOhms with the provided 0.0047 uF capacitor yields a simulated cutoff frequency of 3319.88 Hz, which is within 0.6% of the 3.3 kHz target.

With R = 47 kOhm, standard E12 22 nF yields a cutoff of 153.922 Hz (+2.61% error, exceeding the 2% limit). Using C = 22.6 nF achieves a simulated cutoff of 149.835 Hz (-0.11% error), which meets the 2% target. This capacitance can be realized using a precision film capacitor or a standard 22 nF capacitor in parallel with 560 pF or 620 pF.
Selected standard E96 resistor value of 7.87 kOhms with 10 pF capacitor, yielding a simulated cutoff frequency of 2.0223 MHz (within 1.12% of the target 2 MHz).

A cutoff within 2% of 1.2 kHz cannot be met using only E12 resistor and capacitor values. The closest achievable combination is 3.3 kohm and 39 nF, yielding a simulated cutoff of 1236.63 Hz (3.05% error).

A target cutoff of 7 kHz with a fixed 2.2 kΩ resistor requires approximately 10.34 nF. A single standard E12 10 nF capacitor yields ~7.23 kHz (+3.3% error). Using a parallel combination of standard E12 capacitors (10 nF in parallel with 330 pF, totaling 10.33 nF) achieves a simulated cutoff frequency of 7003.21 Hz, which is within 0.05% of 7 kHz.
